Population increased in Hammersmith and Fulham

The estimated population of Hammersmith and Fulham in 2024 was 188,687 usual residents, a rise of 0.6% since 2023.

This meant that Hammersmith and Fulham's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hammersmith and Fulham increased by 2.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Hammersmith and Fulham was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Hammersmith and Fulham

The average (median) age stayed at 33.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hammersmith and Fulham has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Hammersmith and Fulham is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Hammersmith and Fulham's population of 188,687 usual residents was made up of:

  • 28,480 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.1%)
  • 139,708 people aged 16 to 64 years, (74%)
  • 20,499 people aged 65 years and over, (10.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hammersmith and Fulham has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (74% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hammersmith and Fulham, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hammersmith and Fulham
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hammersmith and Fulham, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,149 people (0.6%). In total, there were 2,055 births and 906 deaths in Hammersmith and Fulham.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 1,442 (-0.8%). There were 24,577 people entering the area and 26,019 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hammersmith and Fulham's population of 1,461 (0.8%) as a result of 6,633 people entering the area and 5,172 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hammersmith and Fulham was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hammersmith and Fulham in mid-2023 is 187,479.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,409 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 106 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,303 people.
